description.value: The study investigated functional connectivity during instructed cognitive reappraisal of peer rejection in depressed versus non-depressed adolescents.

spans.text: The present study reports the neural correlates of cognitive reappraisal in depressed and non-depressed adolescents.

description.value: A two-group, non-interventional study of depressed and non-depressed adolescents with fMRI data acquired during a Chatroom reappraisal task.

spans.text: The data reported here are from the fourth phase of a larger study
Participants were randomly allocated to either a reappraisal condition, or to a non-emotional control training condition

There were no clusters which showed greater connectivity with the seed region during reappraisal versus attend trials in non-depressed versus depressed adolescents.
